findings.title: Validation evidence is not bound to the exact frozen package input
findings.impact: The retained PASS evidence is not proven to have been produced from the exact bytes later frozen by the canonical manifest; filesystem-mtime selection can bind stale or copied evidence.
findings.requiredRemediation: Compute and record a deterministic package/input aggregate hash before validation, require equality in every step/index and freeze script, select by embedded run identity rather than LastWriteTimeUtc, regenerate evidence/reports/manifests, and obtain new convergent AFF-A/AFF-B reviews.
